prompts.title: 动漫角色介绍
prompts.prompt:
PARAMETERS

CHARACTER_NAME = "[CHARACTER NAME]"
STATUS_TEXT_1 = "[ACTIVE]"
STATUS_TEXT_2 = "[MODE: ENGAGE]"
INTERSTITIAL_TEXT_1 = "[SYSTEM LINK]"
INTERSTITIAL_TEXT_2 = "[TARGET LOCK]"
INTERSTITIAL_TEXT_3 = "[FULL DRIVE]"
SUBTITLE = "[CHARACTER TITLE / CODENAME]"
PROJECT_TEXT = "[OPTIONAL PROJECT NAME]"

Create a 15-second premium cinematic character reveal trailer with exactly 13 distinct cuts, 24fps.

Use @[image1] as the sole authority for the character's identity, proportions, outfit, materials, colors and visual style. Never redesign the character. Adapt the environment, abilities, VFX and movement naturally to them.

The overall presentation should feel like a premium AAA action-game character introduction. Motion-design sections use a bold editorial language: oversized condensed typography, clean white or pale-grey fields, huge circular color blocks, thin technical diagrams, concentric rings, halftone textures, tiny interface markings, scan lines, geometric accents, sweeping brush or energy strokes and strong foreground/background parallax. The main palette shifts between black and white, icy cyan, electric blue, neon yellow and warm golden amber. In text-based graphic screens, the typography must appear clearly and be fully readable first, then the character, a cropped close-up or a silhouette may slide in front of it, overlap it or stand beside it. In some graphic-card backgrounds, also use cropped character close-ups or enlarged facial details as integrated design elements.

Use the text parameters above exactly.

CUT 01 | 0.00-1.10s | FACE
Extreme cinematic close-up. Calm focused expression, part of the face naturally obscured by hair, hand, mask or accessory. Shallow depth of field and subtle push-in.

CUT 02 | 1.10-2.20s | ACTIVATION
A signature effect ignites around the character's eyes, hands, body or equipment: glowing rings, symbols, particles, energy filaments, holographic nodes or character-specific effects. The gaze lifts as the effect rapidly peaks.

CUT 03 | 2.20-3.20s | ACTIVE CARD
Hard graphic-match into a bright editorial freeze-frame. Large vivid circular field behind the character, oversized black condensed typography, thin technical circles, tiny UI text, halftone detail and sharp diagonal graphic streaks. Show the typography clearly first, then let the character overlap it or enter beside it. A cropped facial close-up or upper-body close-up may be integrated into the background design.

Typography:
STATUS_TEXT_1

CUT 04 | 3.20-4.10s | ENGAGE CARD
Snap to a high-contrast black character silhouette over a bold horizontal accent-color typography band. The text should read clearly before the silhouette crosses in front of it or locks beside it. A large luminous brushstroke or energy ribbon sweeps diagonally across the foreground with strong motion blur.

Typography:
STATUS_TEXT_2

CUT 05 | 4.10-5.20s | WORLD
Smash cut into a cinematic environment suited to the character. Wide dramatic perspective as they immediately dash, leap, land or burst forward. Fast whip-pan or reactive tracking camera.

CUT 06 | 5.20-6.20s | DETAIL
Fast close or medium shot of one defining ability, weapon motion, gesture, transformation or acrobatic action. Sharp character, strong foreground streaking.

CUT 07 | 6.20-6.90s | INTERSTITIAL 01
Hard cut to a text-led graphic design screen. Huge condensed typography, layered circles, technical lines, scan lines, halftone textures, tiny data text and aggressive graphic wipes. The typography must be fully readable first, then bring in the character as a smaller integrated figure, cropped close-up or silhouette.

Typography:
INTERSTITIAL_TEXT_1

CUT 08 | 6.90-7.90s | IMPACT
Return to action from a new aggressive angle. Attack, dodge, ability release or interaction with a simple secondary threat. Low angle, side track, whip-pan or short orbit.

CUT 09 | 7.90-8.60s | INTERSTITIAL 02
Another editorial text card, cleaner and punchier, built from bold typography, diagonal slashes, accent-color bars, fine UI markings and strong parallax. Let the typography dominate first, then place the character beside it or pass a cropped close-up in front for depth.

Typography:
INTERSTITIAL_TEXT_2

CUT 10 | 8.60-9.60s | VELOCITY
New perspective continues the momentum. Character rushes toward camera, crosses close to lens, launches upward or rapidly changes direction while the environment stretches into controlled speed blur.

CUT 11 | 9.60-10.30s | INTERSTITIAL 03
Final text-based graphic card before the hero beat. Bold oversized typography, sweeping energy stroke, geometric overlays, concentric diagrams and a fast silhouette or cropped character insert. Ensure the text is legible before the character layer overlaps or frames it.

Typography:
INTERSTITIAL_TEXT_3

CUT 12 | 10.30-12.30s | HERO MOMENT
The character performs their most iconic movement, ability, strike, landing or confident stop. Briefly stabilize at the visual peak, then collapse the shot into a bright smear, silhouette frame or graphic-match transition.

CUT 13 | 12.30-15.00s | CHARACTER ID
Premium final identity card. Clean pale background with enormous translucent concentric circles, fine technical arcs, network nodes, subtle halftone texture, tiny graphic markings and restrained chromatic glints. Place the character in a dynamic full-body hero pose overlapping huge condensed typography. The name should register clearly before the character overlap becomes dominant. A large cropped close-up can also be subtly embedded into the background composition.

Behind them, add a large black circular ink-brush or emblem shape containing a ghosted visual motif associated with the character: creature silhouette, symbol, power form, weapon motif or abstract representation of their identity.

Primary typography:
CHARACTER_NAME

Secondary:
SUBTITLE

Optional:
PROJECT_TEXT

Allow the character to overlap the typography for depth.

EDITING:
Very aggressive premium game-trailer rhythm. Hard cuts, graphic matches, whip pans, freeze frames, impact flashes, directional smears, foreground wipes, silhouette transitions and short speed ramps. Every cut must introduce a clearly different composition or visual mode. The text-based interstitial cards should break up the action rhythm and keep the sequence from feeling like uninterrupted combat footage. No slow dissolves or long continuous choreography.

BGM DESIGN:
Create a fast, character-driven AAA game-trailer score tightly synced to the edit. Adapt genre and instrumentation to the character, building from restrained tension into punchy percussion, bass and rising intensity, with clear hits for cuts, typography, transitions and action beats. Peak at the hero moment and finish with a strong final reveal stinger. Integrate subtle UI ticks, whooshes, energy swells and sub impacts into the music.

prompts.title: 史诗对决
prompts.prompt:
【Reference】
图片1＝女主唯一人物身份与服装参考。
图片2＝唯一场景参考：悬空残破东方古桥、云海深渊、断崖、残栏、巨型锁链、远处古建筑。
图片3＝唯一敌人：白骨昆虫机甲，龟裂白骨甲、黑色机械组织、双镰、多肢、触须、残翼、胸腔暖金核心。

严格保持以上角色、服装、敌人、武器、场景一致，全程不换人、不换武器、不切换地点。

30s，16:9，CG国风黑暗奇幻史诗战斗，8K HDR，60fps。纯动作流，无台词、无字幕、无UI、无慢动作、无定格。

女主＝黑红金东方女剑客，重剑轻用、瞬步换位、贴身压迫、借力打力、精准破防。巨剑挥动产生高密度红金液态剑气、暗红流光、金火星。

敌人＝白骨昆虫机甲，双镰俯冲、多肢夹击、桥侧攀附、空中折返、胸甲护核、核心过载暴走。高速移动产生黑白机械流体、冷白碎火、电弧与暗金核心光。

战斗必须势均力敌，双方持续反击，禁止单方面碾压。

0-3s：
第一秒直接开打。机甲从桥侧右上高速俯冲，双镰交叉斩头颈；女主拖巨剑冲锋，贴地滑步横斩。巨剑与双镰正面硬碰，强白闪光＋三层冲击涟漪＋环状冲击波，石板炸裂。双方贴身连续反斩、格挡、回劈、扫腿，眼神始终锁死。

3-10s：
女主红金瞬步连续横斩、斜切、旋身回斩；机甲双镰连续格挡，踏护栏侧翻，倒挂桥侧滑行后重新扑回桥面。二者从桥面打到桥栏、桥侧和半空。女主蹬断石柱跃起，半空格挡第三肢突刺，转体巨剑反劈，削碎机甲肩侧骨甲。桥栏和石柱持续崩裂。

10-18s：
双方0.2秒快速凝能后正面对撞，红金剑气与黑白冲击脉冲炸开，巨链剧烈震荡。机甲突然改变节奏，以双镰＋第三肢＋长尾同时进行上中下三路压制。女主连续格挡但巨剑短暂被锁住，被逼至断桥缺口，脚下桥体大片塌陷，单膝滑向深渊。

18-22s：
女主抓住垂落巨链侧荡躲过贯刺，鞋尖蹬桥壁高速反弹回桥面。她假装正斩胸甲，诱使机甲收拢防御，瞬间发现左肩连接件弱点。重压胸甲→低身滑入左侧→斜上回斩，击碎左肩连接件，再短促横斩翼根联动位。骨甲爆裂，机甲动作首次紊乱。

22-25s：
机甲核心过载暴走，胸腔暖金光暴涨，残翼高频折返，以双镰、长尾、俯冲连续围杀。镜头贴女主背后高速追踪。双方完成暴雨般8连击：横斩→格挡→反刺→回劈→扫尾→偏闪→上挑→震退。女主瞬步、低身滑闪、借护栏反弹、空中回身化解攻击。铁链狂甩，碎石持续坠入云海。

25-28s：
女主借格挡反冲跃至高空，巨剑仅0.2秒凝聚极高密度红金能量。机甲从下方全力仰冲，双镰合拢。双方即将碰撞瞬间，女主0帧横移消失，连续从左后、右上、侧后进行三维高速穿梭斩击，红金残影形成多方向空间剑轨，把机甲核心防线彻底撕开。

28-30s：
俯瞰旋转高潮镜头。所有红金剑轨同时向机甲胸腔核心收束，形成巨型三维半月剑阵＋球状能量漩涡＋环形冲击波。女主从高空全力重劈，传奇巨剑正中暴露核心。

最强白光爆发。

白骨外甲大面积崩裂，黑白机械流体、冷白碎火向外爆散，双镰脱力坠落，机甲半跪失衡，核心逐渐熄灭。

女主重落桥面，震出巨大裂纹，单手持巨剑站定。黑发、裙摆、红色飘带被强风扬起，身后断桥持续崩塌，巨链震荡，碎石坠入翻涌云海。最后女主冷冷抬眼结束。

【物理与生命感】
每次攻击必须有屈膝、拧腰、转胯、重心变化和受击卸力。
发丝、裙摆、红布、触须、翼膜必须持续高速响应动作和风压。
命中必须产生白闪、冲击波、位移、碎甲、碎石。
场景破坏永久保留：护栏崩裂→石板开缝→桥面塌陷→石柱断裂→巨链震荡→断桥持续掉块。

流体55%＋粒子25%＋烟尘雾气碎屑20%。

禁止：血腥、断肢、斩首、穿透、UI、文字、水印、慢动作、定格、动作停顿、站桩对砍、单方面碾压、武器变形、角色变化、机甲变成普通机器人或虫子、穿模、武器穿身、动作无重心、面瘫、衣物静止、特效突然消失、场景自动复原、多余角色。

prompts.prompt:
@image1
设定为第一位角色，完整保留其黑色与暗红色的服装、熔金装饰、华丽而危险的气质、长剑造型、发型、脸部特征以及参考图中的暗黑视觉风格。第一位角色的力量以黑红火焰、熔化的金属、金色火花、暗红能量和高温冲击为主。

@image2
设定为第二位角色，完整保留其蓝黑色服装、冷峻的面部特征、蓝色眼神、精密的金属护甲、长剑设计、冰蓝能量和参考图中的冷冽敏捷气质。第二位角色的力量以冰蓝剑气、深蓝雷电、寒霜、蓝色电弧、水晶碎片和高速能量粒子为主。

制作一段30秒、16:9横屏、电影级动画风格的史诗级高速剑术对决。整体画面达到顶级电影动画和AAA游戏CG的质量。战斗场地必须非常广阔，是一片延伸到地平线的黑色荒原和巨大峡谷。远处有破碎山脉、悬浮岩石、深邃裂谷、被能量撕开的天空、翻涌的乌云和巨大的陨石坑。场地足够宽阔，让两位角色可以进行长距离冲刺、空中战斗、远距离技能对轰和大规模地形破坏。

战斗从第一帧立即开始，30秒内不能停顿、不能静止、不能出现空白镜头。两位角色必须始终处于真实的战斗状态，持续移动、攻击、防御、闪避、追击和反击。双方实力相当，任何一方都不能轻易压倒另一方。每一个技能都必须有不同的动作、不同的视觉效果和不同的攻击方向。动作要快，但必须清楚、连续、容易理解，不要让画面变成无法辨认的混乱闪切。

【0—3秒：快速建立角色与空间】

从image1角色的熔金剑刃极近距离特写开始。镜头沿着剑刃向前移动，黑红火焰和金色熔液在剑身上流动，火星飞散。立即切到image2角色的蓝色眼睛和冰蓝剑锋，冷雾、电弧和细小冰晶在周围闪烁。

镜头迅速拉到超广角远景，展示两位角色分别站在广阔荒原的两端。两人同时冲刺，清楚地朝对方接近。第一位角色先发动强力横斩，释放一道巨大的黑金火焰剑气；第二位角色以低姿态滑步闪避。剑气从身后掠过，将远处的岩层整齐切开，产生巨大的火焰、尘土和碎石爆炸。

【3—7秒：第一位角色连续进攻】

镜头使用侧面跟拍，清楚展示第一位角色向前推进并连续发动三种不同攻击。

第一击是快速横斩，黑红剑气贴着地面横向扩散，切开荒原。
第二击是向上挑斩，熔金火焰从地面爆发，将大量岩石和碎片掀向天空。
第三击是高速旋身重斩，巨大的黑金剑压从上方落下，远处峡谷被直接劈开。

镜头随着每一次攻击改变位置：横斩使用侧面广角，挑斩使用低机位仰拍，重斩使用正面远景展示攻击范围。第二位角色清楚地进行连续闪避、翻身和格挡，每一次防御都产生冰蓝冲击波、火花和碎裂的冰晶。

第二位角色抓住第一位角色攻击后的短暂空隙，立即进行反击。镜头从第二位角色背后进行稳定的高速推进，清楚展示其向前突刺的动作。蓝色剑光沿着直线贯穿荒原，地面被切出一条长达数百米的裂痕。

第二击是向下斜斩，寒霜沿着剑刃轨迹冻结地面。
第三击是空中翻身下劈，冰蓝剑气和雷电同时砸向第一位角色。

镜头分别使用正面中景、低机位侧面镜头和空中俯拍，确保每一次攻击的方向都清晰可见。第一位角色连续格挡，最后被巨大的冲击力推向远处，撞碎一座黑色岩壁，但立即从火焰和碎石中冲出，继续战斗。

两位角色在荒原中央重新接近，进入极快的近身剑术对决。镜头保持在中近景，不要过度快速切换，让观众能够看清剑刃、身体动作和攻击方向。

第一位角色先使用反手斩和旋身上挑，第二位角色用剑身格挡并贴身闪避。第二位角色随后使用低位突刺和蓝色电弧横斩，第一位角色侧身躲开后用熔金剑刃进行反击。两把剑连续碰撞，每次碰撞都产生不同规模的火星、暗红火焰、蓝色电弧和空气冲击波。

镜头围绕两位角色进行平稳的半圆运动，随着剑刃方向移动，但不要出现难以辨认的乱转镜头。每一个动作都必须有明确的起手、攻击、碰撞和结束姿态。

【15—20秒：大范围空中攻击】

第一位角色突然向高空跃起，镜头从地面低机位仰拍，展示其被黑红火焰和熔金碎片包围。第一位角色从高空垂直俯冲，以巨大的黑金熔焰剑压向
第一位角色从高空垂直俯冲，以巨大的黑金熔焰剑压向地面。不要出现任何魔法阵，所有力量都直接集中在剑刃和身体周围。剑压落下时，天空中的云层被切开，地面瞬间下沉，形成巨大的自然裂谷。冲击波向四面八方扩散，远处山体被震碎，岩石和火焰被抛向天空。

【20—24秒：第二位角色的高速空中反击】

第二位角色借助爆炸冲击波跃入空中，开始连续反击。镜头从下方仰拍，清楚展示第二位角色在空中的移动路线。第二位角色先从左侧高速突进，释放一道蓝色雷霜斩；随后在空中翻转，从右侧再次攻击；最后从正上方急速俯冲，释放一道贯穿地面的冰蓝剑光。

两位角色同时落地，分别站在巨大荒原的两端。镜头先使用极远景展示双方之间数百米的距离，以及被破坏的峡谷、碎裂山脉和漂浮岩石。

第一位角色先向前冲刺，沿途拖出巨大的黑红火焰和熔金轨迹。第二位角色也同时冲刺，身后拖着冰蓝雷电、寒霜和水晶碎片。两人高速穿过整个战场，在接近的瞬间同时释放大范围剑气。

黑金熔焰剑气与冰蓝雷霜剑气在半空正面碰撞。碰撞产生的能量必须具有巨大的体积和重量感，形成向天空升起的火焰、冰晶、雷电和岩石冲击。远处的山脉被冲击波削平，地面被掀起，天空中的云层被完全撕裂。

镜头先使用超广角远景展示整个战场的破坏规模，再快速推进到两把剑即将碰撞的中近景。碰撞瞬间使用短暂慢动作，清楚表现两张脸、两把剑和两种能量的正面冲突，然后恢复高速节奏。

【27—30秒：最终正面碰撞】

两位角色被冲击波推开，但立刻再次冲向对方。第一位角色将黑暗火焰、熔金能量和赤红冲击集中在剑刃上，形成一把巨大而炽热的黑金熔焰巨剑。第二位角色将冰蓝能量、深蓝雷电、寒霜和水晶力量压缩到剑身，形成一道锐利的蓝色雷霜巨刃。

镜头使用正面超广角构图，让观众清楚看到两位角色从战场两端高速接近。随后切换为低机位侧面跟拍，展示两人的速度、身体姿态和武器轨迹。最后两把巨型武器在画面中央发生正面碰撞。

碰撞瞬间产生全片最大的视觉冲击：黑金火焰、熔金碎片、冰蓝雷电、巨大冰晶、岩石、尘土和高压能量波同时向四周爆发。地面大范围崩塌，远处山体被冲击波摧毁，悬浮岩石被震飞，天空被黑金和冰蓝两种能量撕裂。爆炸必须具有巨大的空间层次、真实的重量感和电影级破坏规模。

不要出现圆形魔法阵、圆形符文或几何法术图案。冲击波、裂缝和爆炸必须呈现自然、不规则、具有方向性的破坏效果。

最后使用低机位侧面镜头，展示两位角色仍然站立，双方的剑紧紧抵住，黑红火焰与冰蓝雷电持续在剑刃之间爆发。两位角色都没有倒下，双方实力保持平衡。角色的头发、服装、烟尘、火焰、冰晶和能量粒子被持续的冲击风吹动。镜头缓慢向后拉远，展示两位角色、巨大的荒原、破碎山脉和仍在崩塌的天空。不要让画面突然停止，而是以两位角色即将再次出招的动态姿态结束。

【镜头与动作要求】

镜头必须由专业电影摄影指导设计，所有角度都要服务于动作和叙事。大范围技能使用超广角远景和高位俯拍，突出战场规模；强力攻击使用低机位仰拍，突出压迫感；高速冲刺使用侧面跟拍，展示移动方向；近身剑术使用中近景和半圆环绕镜头，保证观众清楚理解双方的动作；最终碰撞使用正面构图和低机位侧面镜头，表现双方势均力敌的力量。

每个攻击都必须清楚呈现起手动作、攻击方向、命中或被格挡的结果，以及攻击后的身体反应。动作必须具有重量、惯性、反作用力和真实的身体重心变化。避免角色无意义地挥剑、漂浮、瞬间消失或没有接触感的能量攻击。

镜头之间使用动作匹配剪辑、爆炸烟尘、飞散碎片、剑光轨迹和角色移动方向进行平滑转场。不要使用毫无逻辑的随机闪切，也不要让镜头过度旋转。即使战斗速度很快，角色的位置、距离、攻击方向和战斗关系也必须容易理解。

【视觉效果要求】

视觉特效必须高级、丰富并且具有真实冲击力。黑金角色的攻击使用暗红火焰、熔金流体、金色火花、黑色烟尘和高温空气扭曲；冰蓝角色的攻击使用冰晶碎裂、蓝色雷电、深蓝冷雾、透明水晶和高速能量粒子。两种元素碰撞时产生真实的相互作用，例如火焰融化冰晶、雷电炸碎熔金、冲击波吹散烟尘、冰晶冻结飞散的火焰碎片。

加入自然的彩虹色镜头折射、轻微棱镜色散、虹彩光晕、金属反光、体积光、动态景深、真实烟尘、环境雾、镜头震动和受控制的运动模糊。彩虹镜头效果只能作为高级电影镜头光学效果，不能遮挡人物脸部、武器和关键动作，也不能让画面变得过度艳俗。

整体画面使用黑金、暗红、熔金、冰蓝和深蓝的电影级调色。角色脸部、眼神、武器和身体动作必须始终清晰稳定。保持两位角色的服装、发型、武器

Prompt (I2V) : Create an extraordinary 15-second photorealistic survival-action sequence beginning exactly from this image. The entire sequence must feel like one continuous, physically connected, unbroken cinematic shot with absolutely no cuts, no transitions, no teleporting camera, no time jumps and no sudden change in geography.

A lone boatman is trapped in a tiny traditional wooden rowboat in the middle of an enormous monsoon-swollen mountain river. The current is violently powerful, filled with whitewater, deep swirling troughs, exposed black rocks and dense cold mist. Towering jungle-covered cliffs disappear into storm clouds on both sides. The tiny human and boat must always feel vulnerable compared with the immense scale and force of the river.

SECOND 0-3:

Begin exactly with the wide composition of the reference image, camera low above the turbulent water looking toward the small boat in the distance.

Immediately bring the scene alive.

Huge uneven waves rise and collapse around the boat. The hull pitches violently forward and sideways while the boatman desperately uses his long wooden oar to keep the bow pointed downstream. Water crashes over the sides.

The camera begins accelerating forward extremely low across the river surface, only centimeters above the foam.

It does not simply zoom.

Physically fly through the environment toward the boat.

Foreground waves rapidly grow larger and create extreme parallax. Spray repeatedly crosses the lens. The camera threads around the large foreground rock, then rises over a breaking wave.

As the camera reaches the boat, sweep around its left side in one fluid motion. Pass close enough to see water streaming from the timber, the boatman's soaked clothing whipping in the wind, his hands fighting the oar, and the hull flexing naturally under impact.

SECOND 3-6:

A deep roar becomes visually apparent ahead.

The river suddenly narrows into a violent rock canyon.

The current grabs the boat and accelerates it dramatically.

Without cutting, the camera rotates around the bow until it is flying backward immediately in front of the boat, almost touching the surface while the boat charges directly toward the lens.

A gigantic dark boulder appears ahead.

The boatman pulls hard on the oar.

The boat swings sideways into a controlled skid across the current, narrowly missing the rock by less than a meter.

The hull climbs halfway up the breaking wave against the boulder.

For an instant the entire boat tilts almost vertically.

The camera sweeps beneath the raised bow, so close that droplets and splintered water fly past the lens, then curves around the other side as the boat slams back onto the river.

A huge burst of water erupts upward.

The man nearly loses the oar but catches it and immediately resumes steering.

SECOND 6-9:

The canyon walls suddenly begin shaking from a landslide above.

Massive rocks break loose from the mist-covered cliffs.

Do not turn this into random destruction. Every falling object must obey gravity and maintain understandable spatial relationships.

The first enormous boulder crashes into the river just behind the boat, creating a towering explosion of water.

The resulting displacement wave lifts the tiny boat several meters upward.

The camera dives underwater beneath the rising boat for less than a second.

Show the dark underside of the wooden hull overhead, violent bubbles, submerged rocks, twisting currents and shafts of pale daylight penetrating the water.

Then the camera bursts back through the surface beside the boat in the same uninterrupted trajectory.

The boat lands hard into the trough.

Another rock crashes ahead and splits the current into two violent channels.

The boat is forced toward the narrower channel.

The camera races alongside at water level while the cliffs close tightly around them.

SECOND 9-12:

The river suddenly disappears ahead.

Reveal an enormous waterfall hidden by mist.

The entire river is pouring over a vast cliff.

The boat is being pulled toward the edge.

The camera rises rapidly from beside the boat into a high sweeping crane-like movement, revealing for the first time that the waterfall drops hundreds of meters into a jungle gorge.

Do not cut.

The camera continues moving physically around the boat while the waterfall edge approaches at terrifying speed.

The boatman spots a fallen tree wedged diagonally between rocks near the brink.

He makes one desperate maneuver.

He drives the oar deep into the current.

The boat turns sharply and rides up the side of a huge standing wave.

Instead of going straight over the waterfall, the wave launches the boat sideways toward the fallen tree.

The camera descends again, rotating around the airborne boat.

For one dramatic instant, the boat is completely clear of the water while the waterfall abyss fills the background beneath it.

The man's body reacts naturally to the sudden weightlessness.

The boat strikes the slick fallen tree with its lower hull, slides along it for several meters and is redirected toward a narrow secondary channel carved into the cliff.

SECOND 12-15:

The boat drops from the tree directly into this narrow torrent.

The camera follows from above, then performs an aggressive corkscrew descent around the boat while both plunge between towering wet rock walls.

Water explodes against the canyon sides.

Branches, foam and spray streak through the frame.

The secondary channel suddenly shoots the boat through a natural stone arch.

Beyond the arch is another violent drop, but this one feeds into a gigantic circular whirlpool surrounded by mist.

The camera passes through the arch immediately beside the boat.

At the final moment, the boat launches from the torrent into open air above the whirlpool.

The camera swings underneath the airborne boat and rotates upward so the tiny wooden vessel is silhouetted against the stormy sky while the massive spinning river is visible far below.

End the 15-second shot at the absolute peak of the jump, just before the boat begins falling, with the boatman still gripping the oar, enormous waterfall mist behind him, jungle cliffs disappearing into cloud and the entire raging river system visible beneath.

The final frame should feel impossible, terrifying and majestic rather than fantastical.

VISUAL AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Extreme photorealism, premium large-format cinema photography, realistic monsoon atmosphere, huge environmental scale, physically accurate turbulent water, believable wooden boat buoyancy and weight, realistic interaction between hull and waves, natural human balance and inertia, detailed foam simulation, millions of water droplets, mist interacting with wind, wet rock reflections, subtle droplets accumulating on the lens, realistic exposure changes when moving through spray and shadow, atmospheric depth through fog, natural motion blur proportional to camera speed.

The camera should feel like an impossible high-end stabilized cinema drone capable of flying inches above water, underwater and around the boat, but it must always travel continuously through real space.

Maintain the exact same boat, same boatman, same clothing, same oar, same river environment and same weather throughout.

prompts.prompt: 创作一场残酷写实的历史奇幻骑兵战斗，以一位骁勇善战的游牧女王为中心，在黄昏时分率领骑兵在广袤的草原战场上发起反击。战斗场面必须连贯完整地讲述一个完整的故事：女王观察敌军骑兵的冲锋，加速进入骑射状态，突破敌军阵型，随后被包围，奋力杀出重围，最终扭转战局，从尘土中脱颖而出。  女战士：一位骁勇善战的游牧女战士，身形精瘦矫健，骑术精湛，皮肤呈古铜色，目光锐利如狐，颧骨高耸，一头乌黑长发编成辫子，饰以珠子和骨饰。她身着层叠的皮革和鳞甲，饰以深色毛皮，脚蹬饱经风霜的马靴，佩戴加固护腕，头戴一顶向后推的角盔。她携带一把反曲弓、一个装满黑羽箭的箭筒和一把短弯刀。  马：一匹身姿矫健、肌肉发达的栗色战马，鬃毛乌黑，配有皮质马具、实用鞍具、汗水浸透的皮毛，以及逼真的战场动作。全程使用同一匹马。  环境：黄昏时分，一片巨大的、被风吹拂的草原战场，高高的黄草被成千上万的马蹄踩平，骑兵阵型消失在尘土中，步兵四散奔逃，燃烧的补给车，断裂的长矛，被遗弃的盾牌，破损的帐篷，倒下的旗帜，以及在烟雾弥漫的橙色天空下剧烈飘扬的红色军旗。  视觉风格：逼真的历史奇幻战争，写实的盔甲，真实的马匹解剖结构和骑乘机制，尘土飞扬的金橙色氛围，强烈的日落逆光，细致的织物物理效果，真实的武器操控，克制的战斗伤痕，火花，烟雾，飞扬的尘土，大气深度，巨大的战场规模，以及围绕女王的神秘气息，但并未赋予她超自然的力量。  镜头语言：开始时采用控制性的电影式观察视角，待女王发起攻击后迅速提升镜头能量。运用环形跟踪、面部特写、侧向骑兵跟踪、越肩弓箭镜头、箭矢追踪视角、低角度拍摄疾驰的马蹄、广阔的战场展现、穿过阵型的激进横向跟踪、短暂的手持地面视角，以及仅在关键战斗场景中使用控制性慢动作。  音效：雷鸣般的马蹄声、马匹的喘息声、皮鞍的摩擦声、盔甲的碰撞声、弓弦的断裂声、箭矢划破空气的声音、远处传来的战斗呐喊声、刀剑的碰撞声、木柴燃烧的声音、风声、骑兵号角声、士兵的呐喊声、马匹的嘶鸣声，以及女王的呼吸声。在战斗声中运用低沉而克制的战争打击乐，避免过于喧宾夺主。  [00:00-00:04] 女王驾临  镜头以优雅的慢动作侧向移动，环绕着女王，她那匹栗色骏马驰骋在战场上弥漫的硝烟中，马蹄践踏着金黄的草丛，女王的辫子、毛皮饰边、箭筒和红色布幔在她身后猎猎作响。镜头缓缓旋转，聚焦于女王的脸庞，她环顾战场，看到敌军骑兵正向她分散的士兵发起冲锋。镜头突然猛地一推，聚焦于女王微微眯起的双眼，只见她镇定地越过肩头，拔出了第一支黑色羽毛的箭。  [00:04-00:08]第一轮  她立刻恢复全速，同时降低身形以对抗马匹的颠簸，在疾驰中拉开反曲弓，射出第一箭，直指逼近的敌方骑兵，紧接着又拉开第二箭。镜头在紧贴她肩膀的过肩视角、与马匹速度相匹配的侧向扫射以及低角度侧身视角之间切换，展现了她如何精准地把握时机，斜穿马群，而非直接冲锋陷阵，射出数箭。  [00:08-00:12] 帕提亚之枪  女王突然策马冲过敌阵，在保持向前冲力的同时，她猛地向后扭转上半身，凭借大腿的力量和骑术保持平衡，同时向后拉开另一支箭。镜头短暂地以慢动作呈现，展现弓弦绷紧的瞬间，然后迅速恢复正常速度，随着箭矢飞驰而过扬起的尘土，镜头随即切回女王，她已拉开另一支箭，身后紧追不舍的骑兵也已准备就绪。  [00:12-00:16] 陷阱  镜头向上拉远，展现出一幅宽广的动态画面：女王的弧形骑行路线巧妙地将部分敌方骑兵引离步兵阵型，使己方骑兵得以从两侧尘土飞扬中突然出现，猛攻暴露的敌方阵型。女王随即调转栗色战马，飞驰于交错的骑兵阵线之间，躲过一支疾驰而过的长矛，近距离射击另一名骑兵，然后险险地从两匹战马之间穿过，镜头也随之旋转，始终保持在女王身旁。  [00:16-00:20] 穿过断线  当她抵达几辆燃烧的战车旁，看到一支步兵阵型摇摇欲坠时，她的箭筒几乎空了。于是她将弓箭横放在身前，拔出短弯刀，策马冲过残破盾牌间的狭窄缝隙。镜头快速交替切换：正面追踪镜头展现她后退躲避冲锋战马的身影；低角度侧视图展现马蹄践踏泥土的瞬间；以及肩部特写，展现她格挡来袭武器、在敌人身后不断攻击的场景。她始终保持移动，而非停下来进行一对一的决斗。  [00:20-00:24] 被包围  女王从步兵后方现身，却发现数名敌方骑兵正透过硝烟向她逼近。她被迫猛拉缰绳，策马急转，马蹄扬起的尘土令她心惊胆战。一名骑兵从左侧逼近，另一名则从后方紧追。女王用弯刀挡住第一击，几乎侧身离开马鞍躲过第二击，然后借助马匹的冲力，冲破两人之间的狭窄缝隙，在被彻底包围之前脱身。  [00:24-00:27] 再次出击  她策马疾驰，奔向一处低矮的山脊，身后三名骑兵紧追不舍。她突然调转马头，横穿敌阵，从箭筒中抽出最后一支箭。镜头紧贴着她，在她疾驰中射出箭矢，随后镜头转向她的身后，展现出她麾下的骑兵正从山脊上涌过。她高举弯刀，数十名骑兵从她身边呼啸而过，冲向残存的敌军阵型，战场随即被扬起的漫天尘土所吞没。  [00:27-00:30] 草原女王  尘埃渐渐散去，女王独自骑马来到前景，将她那匹栗色骏马稳稳地停在俯瞰战场的山脊上，冲锋之后，她和战马都气喘吁吁。她放下大腿旁的弓，燃烧的战车火光在她伤痕累累的盔甲上闪烁，风吹拂着她长长的辫子。在她身后，残存的敌军向远方撤退，而她的红色旗帜在硝烟中升起。镜头缓缓拉近，她疲惫却坚定的神情映照着夕阳西下的战场，画面随即转黑。  女王必须凭借毕生的骑术、战术意识、时机把握、平衡感和射箭经验，而非超自然能力，展现出非凡的技艺。在每一个动作中，都要让她与马鞍和马匹保持紧密的联系，包括真实的缰绳控制、腿部姿势、身体旋转、弓弦张力、武器重量、动量和恢复动作。 prompts.prompt:
Environment: An endless sun-scorched desert at brutal midday, with enormous rolling dunes, cracked patches of earth, distant rocky formations distorted by heat haze, violent gusts carrying sheets of sand across the landscape, and absolutely nowhere for the man to hide. The chase moves continuously across the same desert geography, beginning on open dunes before descending a steep slope, crossing a narrow rocky passage, and reaching a massive cliff edge at the end.

Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic survival action, enormous creature scale, harsh natural sunlight, gritty desert textures, realistic sweat and dust, intense heat distortion, physically accurate sand displacement, dynamic shadows, powerful environmental VFX, natural skin detail, realistic fabric movement, restrained motion blur, dramatic scale contrast, high-energy blockbuster creature-chase atmosphere.

Camera language: Use constantly changing cinematic perspectives to communicate both the man's panic and the impossible scale of the pursuing snake, including front-facing tracking, low-angle foot tracking, over-the-shoulder chase framing, aerial wides, extreme creature close-ups, lateral tracking, ground-level perspectives, POV shots, crane movements, and enormous landscape compositions. Keep screen direction consistent so the man and snake always appear to be moving through the same continuous chase.

Main character: A lone adult traveler wearing dusty desert clothing, rugged boots, lightweight trousers, a sweat-soaked shirt, and a small backpack. His face is sunburned, exhausted, covered in dust and sweat, and increasingly terrified as he realizes the creature is gaining on him. His running should feel desperate and physically exhausting rather than effortless action-hero movement.

Creature: A colossal sand-colored desert serpent hundreds of feet long, with rough scales naturally matching the surrounding dunes, enormous muscular coils, dark predatory eyes, a massive head, powerful jaws, and a body thick enough to displace entire sections of sand as it moves. The serpent does not slither like an ordinary small snake. Its enormous body surges through and beneath the dunes like a living tidal wave, creating collapsing ridges, sand explosions, and huge trails behind it.

Core performance: The man is already running when the sequence begins, initially believing something is following him beneath the sand. The colossal snake violently reveals itself, begins gaining ground, nearly catches him several times, forces him to change direction through increasingly dangerous terrain, and finally corners him at a massive cliff edge. With the snake seconds away from reaching him, the man realizes his only possible escape is jumping.

Audio design: No dialogue-heavy exposition. Use pounding footsteps, desperate breathing, roaring wind, shifting dunes, sand impacts, deep subterranean rumbling, enormous serpent movement, creature hisses, rock impacts, heartbeat-like bass, and an escalating cinematic survival score.

Negative guidance: No gore, no blood, no dismemberment, no duplicated snake, no multiple creatures, no cartoon movement, no dragon features, no legs on the snake, no inconsistent snake size, no disappearing character, no teleporting creature, no unrealistic sand physics, no excessive motion blur, no floating rocks, no changing clothing, no inconsistent desert geography.

[3] TIMESTAMPED STORYBOARD

[00:00-00:04] RUN: Begin with a front-facing tracking shot moving backward at full speed as the terrified man sprints directly toward the camera across the crest of a massive dune, his boots sinking into loose sand while every desperate step throws sand toward the lens. His chest heaves, sweat runs across his dust-covered face, and he repeatedly glances over his shoulder without slowing down as a deep vibration begins shaking the ground behind him. The handheld-style camera introduces subtle controlled shake matching his footsteps while he gasps, “Oh my God... I’m dead!” A huge plume of sand suddenly erupts in the distant background behind his shoulder.

[00:04-00:07] THE REVEAL: Execute a violent whip pan from the running man toward the landscape behind him, revealing an enormous moving ridge cutting through the dunes at incredible speed before the colossal serpent's head explodes through the sand. Thousands of pounds of sand cascade from its scales as it rises above the dunes, opens its enormous jaws, and immediately surges forward. The camera rapidly dollies backward into an extreme wide composition showing the tiny running man in the foreground and the serpent stretching across several dunes behind him, establishing the terrifying difference in scale. SFX: massive sand eruption, deep creature hiss, roaring wind, bass impact.

[00:07-00:10] IT IS GAINING: Cut to an aerial tracking shot looking diagonally downward as the man runs along the ridge of a dune while the serpent follows directly behind, its enormous body weaving through the landscape and carving a serpentine trench across the desert. The creature disappears beneath one dune for a moment before bursting through the next one much closer to him, sending an expanding wall of sand toward his back. The man loses his footing on the steep slope and begins sliding downward while desperately trying to remain upright.

[00:10-00:13] DOWN THE DUNE: Switch to a low side-tracking camera racing parallel to the man as he half-runs, half-slides down the steep dune while enormous waves of sand collapse behind him. The serpent's head suddenly bursts through the dune above and dives down the slope after him, using its enormous weight to accelerate. The camera briefly moves behind the man's shoulder, allowing the audience to see the creature rapidly filling more of the frame while he looks backward and realizes how close it has become. He screams breathlessly, “GO! GO! GO!” at himself while forcing his exhausted legs faster.

[00:13-00:16] ALMOST CAUGHT: Use an extreme ground-level tracking shot beside the man's boots as they hammer across hard desert ground after reaching the bottom of the dune, then rack focus behind him as the serpent's enormous jaws descend toward his position. At the final second, the man dives sideways behind a large rock formation as the snake strikes where he was running, its head smashing through the sand and sending rocks, dust, and debris exploding across the frame. The camera shakes heavily from the impact before immediately following the man scrambling back onto his feet.

[00:16-00:20] THROUGH THE ROCKS: Transition into a tight over-the-shoulder chase shot as the man sprints into a narrow passage between towering desert rocks, believing the enormous creature might be unable to follow him. He looks backward for half a second and sees nothing, allowing a brief expression of relief to cross his face, but then the rock wall beside him violently shakes as the serpent begins forcing its enormous body through the passage. The creature smashes loose sections of weathered stone while pursuing him, and the camera switches to a high overhead view showing the man racing through the narrow corridor while the serpent's huge body bends around the rock formations behind him.

[00:20-00:23] THE STRIKE: The man emerges from the rocky passage into another enormous open section of desert as the camera swings into a wide lateral tracking shot. Without warning, the serpent launches from behind the rocks and strikes horizontally toward him, its enormous head passing only a few feet behind his body. Brief controlled slow motion captures the man's desperate forward dive while the snake's jaws snap shut behind his backpack, tearing the bag away from his shoulders without catching him. The backpack disappears into the creature's mouth while the man hits the sand, rolls violently, and immediately forces himself upright again.

[00:23-00:26] NO WAY OUT: Return to full speed with a front-facing telephoto tracking shot as the exhausted man runs toward the camera, but the camera suddenly cranes upward and backward to reveal something he cannot yet see: the desert ends ahead at an enormous canyon. He continues sprinting until he finally notices the cliff edge, skids violently through the sand, and stops only inches before falling. The camera circles around him as he looks down into the enormous canyon, then slowly turns back toward the desert while the deep rumbling behind him becomes louder.

[00:26-00:28] CORNERED: Use an enormous wide shot from across the canyon as the man stands completely alone at the cliff edge while the serpent emerges over the final dune behind him, its head rising high above the landscape before slowly lowering toward its trapped prey. Instead of immediately attacking, the creature advances deliberately while its gigantic body continues pouring over the dune behind it. The man looks from the approaching serpent to the impossible drop beneath him, breathing violently as wind pulls at his dusty clothes.

[00:28-00:30] JUMP: Cut to a tight close-up as fear gives way to desperate determination in the man's eyes. The serpent suddenly accelerates and launches its head forward with jaws opening behind him. At the final possible instant, the man turns and leaps from the cliff. Switch to a dramatic side-wide composition showing his tiny body falling into the enormous canyon while the serpent's jaws snap shut at the edge only inches behind him, sending a waterfall of sand cascading into the abyss. End mid-fall as the camera dives after the man, leaving his survival unknown. SFX: creature strike, massive jaw snap, rushing wind, falling sand, heartbeat stopping abruptly, hard cut to black.

[4] GLOBAL SUPPLEMENT

The entire sequence must feel like one continuous chase rather than disconnected action shots. Every camera angle should reveal a different part of the same event while maintaining consistent movement direction, desert geography, sunlight, character appearance, serpent design, and distance between predator and prey.

The serpent must remain behind the man throughout the chase and progressively gain ground. Begin with the creature far behind him during the reveal, bring it significantly closer during the dune descent, create the first near-catch around 00:13, allow the rocks to provide only temporary protection, create an even closer strike around 00:20, then completely corner him during the final cliff sequence.

Use the camera to emphasize scale repeatedly. Close shots should communicate the man's panic and physical exhaustion, while aerial and extreme-wide shots should immediately remind the viewer that he is tiny compared with the hundreds-of-feet-long creature pursuing him.

Sand interaction is essential throughout the entire video. The serpent's weight must deform dunes, carve trenches, trigger cascading sand, produce enormous displacement waves, and leave a visible trail through the environment. Its movement should communicate tremendous mass rather than appearing like a normal snake enlarged digitally.

Maintain escalating action without making every second equally chaotic. Use extremely fast movement during attacks and escapes, then briefly slow the pacing before major strikes so the audience can understand the geography and anticipate the danger.

The final jump should remain unresolved. Do not show the man landing, dying, or being caught. End while he is falling into the canyon with the enormous serpent looking down from the cliff above, creating a cliffhanger for the next sequence.

prompts.prompt:
[Source Roles]
@[character ref] defines the Fighter’s complete appearance; ignore its background. Preserve all identity and accessory details.
@[environment ref] defines the architecture, lighting, color, and atmosphere; ignore people and panoramic composition. Reframe it as one connected rooftop temple district.

[Goal and Treatment]
Create a 30-second battle within this district. The Fighter faces one black-metal Cyber-Oni Sentinel with a horned mask, built-in claws, and plasma vents; it actively attacks and counters. High-end painterly anime realism, aggressive sakuga motion, ancient shrine magic rebuilt as cybernetic technology.
Her red-orange magic fires from her hands as bolts, blasts, spinning discs, shock pulses, and luminous rings. Cast only with open palms, broad arm circles, wrist turns, and forceful two-hand projections. No hand seals, finger signs, mudras, ninjutsu gestures, martial-arts spell poses, filaments, or thread-like effects. Each effect has a visible hand origin, path, impact, and quick decay.
[Sequence]
0–4s — Low 24mm tracking races beside her as the Sentinel’s claw shatters a suspended platform. She folds beneath the sweep, pivots through flying tiles, opens one palm, and fires a bolt into its shoulder, forcing it backward as she crosses the gap. End with rings glowing around both palms.

4–9s — Brief 85mm inserts of her eyes and open hands cut into a fast orbit. The Sentinel fires plasma; she sweeps one arm in a circle and a ring expands from her palm, deflecting the blast into a nearby support and exposing its steel core. It shields against fragments, then charges. Keep this cracked support visible.
9–15s — Cut on its charge to a low 24mm push moving with her into the attack. She plants, drives forward, and unleashes a rapid alternating barrage from both open palms; compact bolts pass through spinning wrist rings and hammer its chest, left shoulder, and mask. The Sentinel raises its forearms and advances under fire, but repeated hits split its chest armor, blast away the left shoulder plate, and force one knee into the roof. She steps closer with every volley and finishes with a two-palm ring blast that hurls it onto the torii platform aligned with the cracked support. End with its chest broken and left arm sparking as it forces itself upright.

15–21s — Cut on its counterattack to an overhead dive. Using its intact right claw, the Sentinel hurls a roof slab at her. She thrusts both palms forward; a broad spell ring pulverizes the slab and hits the Sentinel behind it, throwing both fighters and debris across the gap. End with both airborne as it twists to attack again.

21–26.5s — The camera drops beside them without exposing the skyline. She fires bolts through staggered rings that accelerate each shot. The Sentinel bats two aside with its intact claw, shields with debris, then lunges through the barrage. She opens a larger ring across its vector, bending it through the torii corridor and onto the damaged platform. Both land and slide apart. End with it rising beside the cracked support and charging.
26.5–30s — Stay at rooftop level. The Sentinel drives its intact claw at her. A low lateral track follows her slipping outside the strike and planting her feet; she sweeps both arms outward, forms three concentric rings around her wrists and palms, then drives both hands forward. The rings fire one focused blast that carries it through the neon torii frame and into the cracked support. Its steel core buckles around the Sentinel as a compact shock ring blasts dust, sparks, tiles, and fading glyphs past the lens. Hold through recoil. End in a tight low two-shot: she stands foreground with lowered glowing palms; the damaged Sentinel strains while pinned behind her. No city reveal.

[Camera, Motion, Audio, Continuity]
Use compressed anticipation, explosive travel, readable contact, one micro hit-stop, recoil, overshoot, and immediate re-entry. Couple camera movement to each attack; cut on contact, vector change, counter-initiative, or causal handoff. Preserve screen direction and local geography. Use 24–35mm for action and 85mm only for inserts; strong foreshortening, parallax, foreground streaks, and controlled impact smears, never random shake. Use close-ups, medium shots, and local wides; never pull back to a city panorama. Hair, jewelry, debris, and magic follow body impulse; hair never hides her face.

No BGM or score. Use local ambience, breath, footfalls, servos, ring resonance, magic blasts, impacts, debris, and the final shockwave.

Keep exactly one Fighter and one Sentinel. Preserve her referenced appearance, accessories, anatomy, and hands. Preserve the district, action axis, cracked support, broken chest armor, missing left shoulder plate, and sparking left arm through the ending. Keep ring design consistent. No duplicates, costume changes, added weapons, transformations, or location resets.

prompts.title: The Last Toy
prompts.prompt:
[GLOBAL] A complete scene in ONE generation, about 30 seconds, told in 13 numbered shots in order — real time runs continuously from shot to shot inside each location, each shot beginning where the last ended; the only exceptions are two cuts: a MATCH CUT into the sunlit memory at Shot 9 (identical framing, only the world changes) and a HARD CUT back out of it at Shot 12. Photoreal, raw unedited camera footage — natural and practical light only, slightly low contrast and low saturation, flat muted natural tones, NO color grading, not cinematic, looks like real footage straight off the camera. CAMERA: very shaky handheld throughout — constant organic jitter, drift and breathing sway, heavier on movement, never smooth, never stabilized — with ONE exception: Shots 8 and 9 are a LOCKED-OFF STATIC camera, completely still, identical to each other, so the match cut lands. TWO ENVIRONMENTS, same raw look: the bunker (match  ) lit only by its one failing fluorescent tube, cold and dim, dust hanging in the light; the memory (match  ) lit only by direct afternoon sun on a highway through red poppies with a huge dam behind, bright and warm because of the sun, not because of grading. NOAH: in the bunker (Shots 1–8, 12–13) match   exactly — late 30s, dark messy hair, dark beard, goggles pushed up over a dark bandana, grey henley under a combat vest, RED GLOVES, dirty with dried tear tracks; in the memory (Shots 9–11) match   exactly — the SAME man clean, no vest, no goggles, no gloves, bare hands. GHOST: in the bunker (Shots 1–8, 12–13) match   exactly — a ZOMBIE-LIKE MUTATED husky-wolfdog: fur fallen out in large patches exposing grey-black cracked skin and open sores, dark veins under the skin of the muzzle and neck, bony ridges pushing up along its spine, one ear torn, the jaw slightly elongated with uneven overlong teeth and black gums, black fluid seeping from nostrils and eye corners, MILKY WHITE clouded eyes, in heavy tactical armor with rusted half-torn straps, goggles pushed up on its forehead (one lens cracked) so both eyes are always visible; in the memory (Shots 9–11) match   exactly — the SAME dog clean and healthy, full fur, no sores, no armor, no goggles, clear pale blue eyes. THE RABBIT (match   exactly): a small worn brown plush rabbit in a tiny blue-and-red vest; it lives in Noah's chest vest pocket and, once given, stays in the dog's mouth or between its paws to the end. THE RIFLE: a camo rifle, raised in Shot 1, lowered, set on the floor in Shot 6, never fired, lying untouched in every later bunker shot. THE ENDING (Shots 12–13): back in the bunker Noah is DEAD on the floor — the dog has killed him, his throat torn open, and it is FEEDING on his body; he never moves again; the dog's whole body works as it feeds. ACTING: emotion only as visible physical behaviour, never named — Noah's is in the trembling lower lip and the breath that catches; the dog's is in ears, lips over the fangs, nostrils, the angle of its head. Nobody is ever completely still: breathing, blinking, tremor. No on-screen text of any kind, no letters on any wall, no logos, no signage. MUSIC: a sparse, cinematic, emotional score — a low sustained string drone and single piano notes only, no percussion, no full orchestra hits, always beneath the diegetic sound and the one spoken line. MUSIC ARC (follows the story exactly): Shots 1–7 the low string drone barely audible with a few very sparse single piano notes that never resolve; Shot 8 the piano stops as the rabbit is offered and only the drone remains; on the MATCH CUT into Shot 9 the drone opens into warm, gentle sustained string harmony — the warmest, most tender music in the film — holding through Shots 9–11 under the wind and laughter; on the HARD CUT into Shot 12 the music is CUT DEAD mid-phrase, silence except the feeding sounds; halfway through Shot 13 a single very low string drone creeps back in under the feeding, never rising above it, and holds to the end. Diegetic sound is always in front of the music, cued exactly on the action: a low continuous growl that stutters and drops, Noah's ragged breathing, the rifle's metal CLICK, a knee hitting tile, fabric, the wet click of jaws closing on cloth — the click continues across the match cut — then in the memory bright wind, panting, claws on asphalt and Noah's laughter — then on the hard cut back ALL of that stops dead and the bunker is only this: the fluorescent tube buzzing, and the dog FEEDING — wet tearing of cloth and flesh, heavy chewing, a low continuous feeding growl, teeth scraping bone, a thick drip onto tile, the body's dead weight shifting and thudding as it is pulled. These feeding sounds are loud, close, detailed and continuous to the end; nothing softens them.

Shot 1: close-up, eye-level, very shaky handheld, tight on Noah's face and the rifle stock at his cheek, the muzzle out of frame toward the right: tears sit in his beard, his lower lip trembles, the rifle sight jitters — his right hand on the grip is shaking — his left hand clamped white-knuckled on the fore-end, breath coming ragged through his nose.

Shot 2: close-up, low angle at the dog's head height, very shaky handheld, GHOST filling the frame with the rifle muzzle hovering soft-focus in the left foreground: goggles up on its forehead, one lens cracked, milky white eyes fixed past the muzzle at him, lips peeled off wet fangs, a saliva string swinging; a low GROWL rolls continuously, and one front paw slides half a step forward on the grit.

Shot 3: medium wide profile two-shot, eye-level, shaky handheld, Noah on the left, the dog on the right about three metres apart, the faded red symbol on the wall behind them, the fluorescent pool of light between them: Noah's rifle wavers. He swallows, and says very softly, barely voice: "Hey… hey, buddy. It's me." — the dog's ears FLICK at the sound, the growl stutters and breaks for one beat — then its lips peel back again and the growl resumes, lower.

Shot 4: close-up, eye-level, shaky handheld on Noah: he lowers his head, drags the back of the red glove across his cheek, closes his eyes, and the rifle barrel sinks down and out of the bottom of frame; his thumb finds the selector and it CLICKS.

Shot 5: close-up on the dog, eye-level, shaky handheld, the muzzle dropping away out of the top of frame: the clouded eyes follow it down, the growl drops half a register, nostrils working, the paw that was forward staying planted.

Shot 6: medium wide profile, shaky handheld, same framing as Shot 3: Noah lays the rifle flat on the tiles and slides it away from himself with a scrape, then lowers one knee to the floor, then the other, slowly, both red gloves open at his sides, and settles back onto his heels, smaller than the dog now.

Shot 7: close-up, high angle, shaky handheld, over Noah's shoulder on his right hand at the chest vest pocket: two fingers hook out the worn plush rabbit, turn it once so the tiny vest and frayed ear show, and he extends his arm slowly toward the dog, holding the rabbit out at the dog's head height in his open red-gloved palm, arm trembling slightly, and holds it there.

Shot 8: THE OFFER — medium close-up from Noah's side, CAMERA LOCKED OFF and completely static for this shot (no handheld movement at all), low just behind and above his outstretched right arm, looking over his red-gloved hand and the rabbit in his palm (lower left of frame, soft) at the dog's face centred beyond it, the bunker's cold fluorescent light and the faded red wall symbol out of focus behind: the mutated dog's nostrils twitch — twice — it leans in and SNIFFS the rabbit, black fluid glistening at its nose; the snarl loosens, the lips sliding back down over the uneven teeth by degrees, the head lowering an inch at a time; and as its jaws open and begin to close GENTLY around the rabbit, the milky film over its nearer eye THINS, a patch of clear pale blue showing through, the pupil finding him. The shot ends on the exact frame the jaws touch the cloth.

Shot 9: MATCH CUT — the SAME shot: CAMERA LOCKED OFF and completely static, identical lens, camera height, angle and composition as Shot 8 — camera low behind and above Noah's outstretched right arm, his hand and the rabbit lower left of frame, the dog's face centred beyond it, the dog in exactly the same position and mid-way through exactly the same movement, jaws closing on the rabbit — but the world has changed: the hand is now BARE and clean, no glove (Noah as @image2); the dog is GHOST healthy (match @image4) — full clean fur, no sores, no armor, no goggles, clear pale blue eyes, ears up; the background is the sunlit poppy highway (match @image7), red poppies and the dam wall out of focus behind, blinding warm golden light, wind. The dog finishes closing its jaws on the rabbit with the same soft click, gives one playful tug, and Noah lets go; the dog spins with the rabbit and trots away down the road, and Noah's bare hand drops out of frame as he rises, laughing, to run after it.

Shot 10: low ground-level wide, shaky handheld, on the warm asphalt, the dam wall filling the sky: Noah lies flat on his back on the road, chest heaving with laughter, while the dog circles him at a bounce, drops the rabbit on his chest, snatches it up again and circles the other way.

Shot 11: close-up, ground level, shaky handheld, Noah's face on the asphalt in golden light: the dog's muzzle comes in and LICKS his bearded cheek, he laughs out loud, pushes its head away with one bare hand and immediately pulls it back in, forehead to forehead, eyes shut, still laughing.

Shot 12: HARD CUT — close-up, ground level, shaky handheld, the SAME framing as Shot 11 but in the bunker's cold fluorescent light: Noah's face lies on the tiles where it lay on the asphalt, eyes open and fixed, mouth slightly open, no breath, dust on the wet of his eye; his throat and the collar of the henley are TORN open, dark blood spread wide across the pale tiles under his head; and where the dog's muzzle came in to lick his cheek, the mutated dog's head is now down at his neck, working — the fur of its ruff filling the edge of frame, wet tearing and chewing loud and close, its low feeding growl continuous. Every sound from the memory is gone.

Shot 13: WIDE SHOT, eye-level from across the bunker, very shaky handheld as if held by someone who does not want to be there, the whole room in frame under the single failing fluorescent tube, the faded red symbol on the back wall: Noah's body lies on its side in the centre of the pool of light, the camo rifle untouched a metre from his open red-gloved hand, the worn plush rabbit dropped on the tiles beside him — and the mutated dog stands OVER him, straddling the body, head down, FEEDING: its shoulders and haunches work with each pull, the body jerks and slides a few inches across the tiles with the force of it, a strip of grey henley tears free, dark blood spreading out from under him toward the camera. The dog does not look up. SOUND is the whole shot: the tube BUZZING, wet tearing, heavy chewing, teeth grinding on bone, the low continuous feeding growl, the thick DRIP of blood off the edge of the tiles, the scrape of the body being dragged. It goes on. Hold on it. End.

场景始终是同一座“Dead Frequency City”：倒悬摩天楼、断裂高架、中央广播塔、黑色数据深井和悬空单轨构成固定空间锚点，人物与破坏遵循统一可读的重力方向。第一镜建立单轨及未启动的供能节点，结尾回到同一线路。Frequency Core是唯一的悬浮橙色晶核，取出后始终属于Shift，直到嵌入耳机。

城市安全系统必须像完整的主动防御网络，而不是简单背景：核心离槽立即触发全城机械警报、红色旋转警灯、脉冲式应急照明、重型防爆闸门、桥面锁栓、移动激光扫描网、追踪探照灯和墙体电缆拦截器。Noise Warden是该系统唯一的人形中枢，由巨大无面黑色信号面具、暗紫电缆、破碎屏幕和洋红能量带构成；它能同时读取监控节点、预测Shift路线、依次关闭出口、改变桥段角度、发射拦截索并在受挫后重新计算攻击，不得站立等待。

宽银幕3D动漫游戏电影质感，漂白黑白城市配合边缘RGB错位，饱和橙色专属Shift、核心与她的能力，红色专属警报，洋红与黑色专属敌方系统，酸青用于城市线路。能量有明确来源、体积、遮挡、反射和接触结果；衣料、发梢、碎屑与电缆按真实加速和碰撞滞后。3D世界、粗线漫画和丝网印刷图形是三个明确状态，只通过可见编辑边界切换。

0-3秒：三镜建立潜入。18毫米极远景穿过倒悬建筑找到正在正常奔跑的Shift；低位侧跟拍清楚显示交替脚步跨过断桥接缝；肩后近景随她到达广播终端，核心、远处单轨节点和一枚尚未亮起的安全摄像头同时入画。声音只有风、脚步、金属震动和微弱电流。

3-7秒：五次递进短切完成盗取与封锁。微距见她解除机械锁环，连接丝先被拉紧再断开，核心完整离槽；离槽瞬间所有环境声抽空一拍，随后三段式机械警报猛烈响起。红色警灯依次点燃到城市深处，防爆闸门砸落，桥面锁栓弹出，探照灯转向，摄像头光圈张开，移动激光网从出口两侧合拢。核心离槽后的第一轮红色警报形成独立hero frame：巨大英文“ALERT”以单行正面构图占据约百分之八十画面，锋利窄体字母随三段警报做一次强烈亮灭脉冲，先保持完整清晰，再分裂成厚重红色横向警报条，从前景高速扫向城市深处；每经过一层建筑就点亮警灯、砸落闸门并启动扫描网。Shift握紧核心、触碰耳机并释放无文字的橙色扫描波，暂时熄灭最近的激光网并标出逃生路线。

7-10秒：安全网络反击。俯视看报警波沿整座城市传播，防爆门逐区关闭；墙面屏幕碎片翻转，暗紫电缆从监控节点汇入中央塔，组装成Noise Warden。它抬起面具，所有探照灯同时把Shift钉在同一位置；两行英文状态语“CAGE ACTIVATED”在正面锁定构图中完整出现，第一行由四块巨型防爆闸门的正面拼成粗重主标题，第二行像机械状态条一样在其下逐字锁定，每个位置伴随金属click。保持清楚可读后，第一行字母向前后景延伸成实体笼柱，第二行化为环绕笼体的扫描刻度；Warden同步关闭前方出口、升起侧方桥段并从后方发射电缆索，迫使她转入中央服务桥。

10-14秒：五镜安全追逐，全程保持正常跑步。侧面广角跟随Shift沿水平服务桥快速奔跑，脚掌每一步都有明确触地和蹬离；前方两道闸门交替下砸，她穿过仍然可达的开口，闸门在身后撞地。正面长焦看到扫描激光由上向下扫来，她在继续跑动中压低上身通过，不跪地滑行。桥面锁栓从脚边连续升起，她改变步幅绕开；Warden预测新路线并旋转前方桥段，她从稳定边缘正常起跳，越过缺口，双脚落地屈膝后立即恢复交替跑步。两条拦截索击穿她刚离开的栏杆并拉塌桥侧，唯一剩余路线指向中央广播塔。

14-17秒：Warden让塔前防爆门封死并把多条能量带压缩为一束主攻击。低位广角建立Shift、攻击束和塔体接收环的同一轴线。她急停转身，以核心展开完整橙色圆盾；攻击接触时3D画面短暂切成黑白橙漫画impact frame并进入hit-stop，两行英文状态语“ATTACK BLOCKED”完整出现，第一行较小且紧贴攻击轨迹，第二行以超粗重字占据大部分画面。保持读清后，第二行字母像装甲印刷块一样砸入盾面并成为承力结构，攻击把字母向内压缩，边缘爆出墨迹、星形冲击框和网点碎屑；字母回弹但不破裂。画面恢复3D，Shift改变盾角，把攻击连续偏转进中央塔接收环。声音在接触前静默半秒，只留呼吸、警报余响和盾面应力声。

17-20秒：接收环过载，安全网络的红色警灯、酸青线路与Warden洋红电缆同时反向闪烁。Warden主动切断外围电缆并后撤，试图隔离故障，但被防爆门和锁栓固定的主线路来不及脱离；五道光柱折向同一交点。短暂减速确认Shift、盾面、面具与交点关系，随后冲击恢复全速。两行英文状态语“SYSTEM BREACH”在交点正面完整出现，第一行像细窄系统标签横跨上方，第二行以巨大粗体压住整个交点。读清后，能量从第二行中央贯穿，单一裂缝沿真实受力方向穿过两行文字、人物前后景和整块画面；主词被压扁并向摄影机爆出实体字母碎片，裂缝成为下一镜的编辑边界。塔环断裂、部分警报熄灭、Warden被拉离平衡，Shift连同核心被推向右上方，所有损坏继续保留。

20-23秒：沿字母裂缝硬切。Shift在空中把核心拉回胸前，橙色数字秘术阵在城市上空展开；四道垂直光槽把建筑尺度的黑橙巨门从天空高速拉下。门体重砸在Shift与Warden之间的断桥上，桥面下沉、碎石向外爆开，表现巨大质量。正面锁定门体，两行英文状态语“GATE SUMMONED”完整出现：第一行是建筑尺度的主标题，四个巨型字母本身构成门楣、侧柱、锁具与双扇门；第二行是刻在上方魔法封印环中的细窄状态文字。整组保持完整可读，随后封印环转动、第二行发出一次确认闪光，核心脉冲驱动字形锁具依次解开。巨门沉重向内开启，显露黑白墨线、橙色丝网印刷和无底纵深构成的异空间。Shift沿原有动量进入，Warden立即从门外射出最后一束能量矛。

23-25秒：门内保持Shift的姿态、方向、核心归属和动量。黑色刷痕、网点、错版色层、手绘轮廓与抽象字形碎片形成高速图形走廊，不生成额外可读文字。入口门开始闭合，能量矛只有前端越过门槛；双扇门在矛身上合锁，将攻击切断。门外能量反抽回Warden，门内前端成为携带剩余电荷的洋红能量刃，继续跟随Shift前进。

25-27秒：同一门扉的出口在中央塔高空开启，Shift和能量刃保持原方向回到同一3D城市。她在自由坠落中用橙色圆盾接住能量刃，再沿盾面圆弧把它偏转到开场建立的单轨供能节点；节点吸收剩余敌方能量并启动列车。出口闭合成橙色符文光点，不留下第二座门。

27-30秒：Shift有重量地落上加速中的列车车顶，双膝压缩吸收冲击，随后立刻向前正常跑三步，每一步脚掌完整触地再离开，绝不滑行；她站稳后把核心嵌入耳机接口。橙色信号波沿车顶、轨道和城市线路传播，驱散Warden残余电缆。85毫米正面特写中，她推正眼镜、肩膀放松、呼吸平稳。同步完成时画面锁定，两行英文状态语“SYNC COMPLETE”完整出现，第一行巨大，第二行较小并保持居中。最初橙色、酸青和洋红三层字形彼此错位，随后每个字母伴随清脆click依次对齐；最后一层对齐时整组变成单一锐利橙白文字，城市灯光、列车脉冲和音乐节拍同时同步。一条橙色波形从文字边缘延伸为发光轨道结构，最后约1.2秒不切镜。

声音从低风和脚步开始，核心离槽立即触发响亮三段式警报、旋转警灯电机、闸门重砸、锁栓弹出、探照灯转动、激光扫描和电缆发射；随后加入工业breakbeat、机械低音与无线电噪声。塔体过载时警报失真并逐层熄灭；巨门下坠使用低沉数字钟声、空气压缩、重型撞击和门轴轰鸣；门内加入印刷摩擦与纸张撕裂；回到3D时切换为高空风压。无对白，不添加字幕。除上述六条事件状态语外不出现任何文字、标题、口号、标志或HUD。

保持同一个Shift、一个核心、一个Noise Warden和同一安全网络。警报触发后持续到塔体过载，已关闭闸门、升起锁栓、断桥、屏幕裂口、塔环损坏和断裂电缆不得重置。门的入口与出口属于同一法术实例；被切断的能量前端持续到供能节点吸收。所有连续镜头使用可达路径并延续运动方向、物体归属、损坏和安全状态。

prompts.title: 两个武士对决
prompts.prompt:
严格使用两张参考图中的两名角色作为主角，保持两人的脸部、发型、服装、体型、年龄感、气质、武器与整体轮廓不变，不换脸，不换装，不改变发型，不增加第三主角。

角色设定

角色A（青衣浪客）
成年东亚男性，长发束起，面容疲惫冷峻，穿破损青绿色武士袍与深色披风，腰间佩刀，气质沉稳、苍凉、压迫，像经历过大战后的顶级剑客。
特效体系A：苍青爆风系 / 灰烬冲击系 / 烟尘裂爆系。
技能表现为：

苍青色高速刀风
压缩空气形成的爆裂冲击波
灰尘、碎石、灰烬被刀压卷起
重斩时伴随低沉爆炸、地面崩裂、气浪炸开
整体质感偏厚重、硬派、毁灭感强

角色B（赤袍剑客）
成年东亚男性，长发高束，面部有尘土血痕，穿破损红色长袍，动作更凌厉、更主动，气质锋利、炽烈、侵略性强。
特效体系B：赤焰流刃系 / 血风残叶系 / 高速灼裂系。
技能表现为：

赤红色高速刀弧
像燃烧残叶与红色流风混合的斩击尾迹
爆发时有灼热爆闪与赤色旋流
位移时带出红色残流与撕裂空气的弧线切痕
整体质感偏迅猛、华丽、锋利、杀意极强

场景设定

场景为一片古代大战后的战场废墟，与两张参考图保持统一世界观。
环境包括：

满地尸体、兵器残骸、断旗、泥土、飞灰
远处战火与爆炸烟柱
大量破碎红旗与血色碎布在风中翻卷
地面干裂、尘土厚重，可被冲击波掀飞
空气中持续漂浮灰烬、烟雾、火星、尘埃
阳光冷硬，整体是末日战场 + 武士决战气氛

战斗要求

30秒纯享高燃双人对决视频。
全片只有这两名主角持续战斗。
必须是超快节奏、强逻辑、连续攻防、顶级剑戟决战。
不能站桩摆pose，不能慢吞吞蓄力，不能无逻辑乱砍。
每一次攻击都必须有回应：
A出招 → B格挡 / 闪避 / 反打 → A再接续变化。

运镜要求

真人电影级战斗镜头，16:9，4K/8K质感，顶级动态范围。
镜头整体以高速环绕式摄影为主，混合：

穿越机环绕
贴地追踪
低机位高速推进
半环绕绕背
Whip Pan急甩
推近 / 拉远
升降机位
高速贴身侧绕
大碰撞瞬间短震
大招碰撞时镜头被冲击波推开

镜头必须一直服务战斗逻辑，始终看清人物动作、刀路、碰撞点与位移关系。

总体风格

高燃、快节奏、电影级、超帅、压迫感强。
特效必须高级、克制、有真实重量感。
不是廉价网游光效，不是随便加光条。
必须是：
刀路 + 爆炸 + 气浪 + 地表破坏 + 烟尘回卷 + 红布飞卷 + 灰烬炸裂
共同组成的顶级战斗视觉。

0s—5s｜开场对峙后瞬间爆发

开场直接从大战场废墟中进入状态。
角色A立于爆炸烟柱与残旗之间，披风和青衣被强风掀起，右手握刀。
角色B从另一侧高速冲入，红袍卷起大片赤色残流与碎布。
没有长时间对视，1秒内直接开打。

角色B先攻，利用极速滑步与低身突进，一刀横斩逼入。
角色A立即拔刀迎击，苍青刀风与赤色流刃第一次正面相撞。
第一次碰撞就爆出巨大气浪与火光尘爆，地面碎石和尸体旁的兵器残片被震飞。
随后两人以极快速度连续三到四轮攻防交换：

B连续斜斩、反撩、突刺
A以最短刀路格挡、卸力、反切
两人边打边高速换位
镜头沿两人外侧高速环绕，保持双方始终处于画面中心

这一段重点是：
建立两人风格差异

B更快、更锐、更主动
A更稳、更重、更有爆炸性反击

⸻

5s—10s｜高速追斩与第一轮技能展开

B借一记上撩逼退A，随即发动赤焰残风突进。
他整个人化作一道红色高速流影，沿地面连续折线移动，刀锋拉出多道赤色残弧，连续从不同角度切向A。
A不后退，而是以短步换位和极小幅度转身连续格挡。
每一次挡刀都爆出苍青色压缩气爆与灰尘炸裂。

随后A突然抓住B换刀间隙，一刀重压斩击落下，触发苍青爆风重斩：

苍青刀压伴随强烈空气爆鸣
地面被刀气压出裂纹
大量尘土、碎甲、断矛同时炸起
爆炸式冲击波把B直接震退十几米

B滑地稳住，靴底犁出长长泥沟。
镜头贴地追着B后退，再在他停住的瞬间快速绕到侧后方。
B抬头，眼神杀意更重，红袍猛然一甩，整个人再度爆冲回战场中央。

⸻

10s—15s｜近身连斩与大范围环境破坏

两人重新贴身对撞，进入最凶狠的中近距离连续刀战。
这段动作必须非常密：

刀背架挡
反手回斩
压刀抢中线
擦身闪避
转髋回切
蹬地换位
踏尸体残骸借力起跳
低身滑铲式切入
空中短暂交锋后再次落地

B发动自己的中段技能：赤叶爆斩轮舞。
他高速旋身连斩，红色刀弧层层叠叠扩散，像大量染血落叶和热风混成的斩击风暴。
刀弧扫过之处：

地面被撕开
红旗残布被切碎卷飞
周围战场残兵器成片弹起

A不硬吃，而是边退边挡，随后突然正面踏入风暴中心，用一记苍青裂地上挑斩直接破开红色斩击层。
这一刀从下向上撕开B的攻势，伴随一声沉重爆炸，周围地面像炸药引爆一样整片崩裂，泥土与尸体旁的碎盾、刀片、石块一起被轰上天空。

⸻

15s—20s｜空中交锋与双特效全面升级

两人被爆炸冲击一同掀入半空。
镜头瞬间拉远，然后高速围绕两人空中环绕。
A与B在半空中连续三到五轮高速交锋：

A横斩，带出苍青爆风冲击
B翻身闪过，红色流刃反切
A空中转体下压重斩
B借刀身格挡，借力后翻，再从侧面刺入
两人的刀在空中疯狂碰撞，爆出密集光点、爆风和空气环

此时两人的特效都进一步升级：

A升级效果：
苍青刀风更厚重，像压缩风暴与战场灰烬混合，挥刀时会引发局部爆破与冲击波，像一刀斩出一场近距离炮击。

B升级效果：
赤色流刃更锋利、更炽烈，像燃烧的布帛和鲜血色旋风高速抽打空间，每一次加速位移都拉出极长的红色灼裂轨迹。

空中最后一次对拼后，两人同时落地，地面发生双重落点爆炸。
镜头被冲击波推开，随后迅速再冲回。

⸻

20s—25s｜各自大招对轰

进入全片最炸的一段。
两人短暂错开，各自启动代表性大招，但不能原地读条太久，必须在高速移动中蓄势与释放。

A的大招：苍青灭阵崩斩

A拖刀疾冲，沿地面高速拉出一道苍青爆风裂沟。
随后一跃而起，双手持刀从高处斩下。
刀光落地时，形成一条贯穿战场的巨大苍青爆裂斩轨：

地面沿斩线连续爆炸
巨量烟尘与尸骸、兵器残骸被掀飞
冲击波向两侧炸开
背后火焰烟柱被刀压从中切开
B的大招：赤血残阳轮杀
B沿另一侧高速绕行，整个人化作红色风暴，连续三次闪身切位。
每次切位都留下赤色残斩轨迹。
第三次位移后，他猛然回身，一刀斩出巨大的赤色旋流月牙。
月牙像血色风暴一样卷着红布、尘土、热浪与残旗碎片高速推进。
两股大招在战场中心正面相撞。
爆出全片最大规模的第一次大碰撞：
苍青爆风 vs 赤色流刃
巨大球形冲击波向四面八方炸开
残旗、碎石、武器、尘浪全被掀起
附近地面整体塌陷
镜头被强行冲飞后再急速拉回
⸻
25s—30s｜最终决胜对斩
大招对撞后，两人都没有停。

A蓄出最后一记苍青重爆居合斩
B也同时发动最后一记赤焰残月瞬斩

赤色流刃横向扫开
两种不同特效在人物交汇点形成“十字爆斩”

prompts.title: 皮肤
prompts.prompt:
Create a premium vertical 9:16 cinematic beauty editorial photograph.

SUBJECT:
A beautiful young East Asian woman in an extremely intimate close-up portrait.
Only part of her face is visible in frame.

She has refined natural East Asian facial features, dark brown-black hair, with a few loose strands naturally crossing the forehead and cheek.

Her expression is quiet, calm, slightly distant and introspective.
She is not posing for the camera.
Her gaze is slightly downward or away from the lens.

Natural soft pink lips, minimal makeup, almost no visible cosmetic styling.
The beauty should come primarily from skin, light, texture and atmosphere.

COMPOSITION — CRITICAL:
Extremely intimate close-up framing.

The face occupies most of the upper and middle frame.

One eye, part of the nose, cheek and lips become the main visual anchors.

Do not show the full face perfectly.

Allow the composition to crop:
- part of the forehead
- part of the cheek
- part of the lips
- part of the jaw
- part of the hair

Do not center the face perfectly.

The composition should feel accidental, elegant and editorial rather than conventionally beautiful.

Leave intentional negative space somewhere in the image for a very small line of typography.

The image should feel like a real luxury skincare editorial, independent fashion magazine beauty story or experimental beauty campaign photographed by a real photographer.

Not a normal portrait.
Not a commercial beauty headshot.

SKIN — CRITICAL:
The skin must look extremely realistic and tactile.

Visible:
- natural pores
- micro skin texture
- fine facial texture
- tiny irregularities
- subtle peach fuzz
- natural tonal variation
- slight imperfections

Most importantly:

The skin must have a clearly visible hydrated water-oil sheen.

It should look as if a very thin transparent layer of:
skincare essence,
facial oil,
serum,
moisture
or freshly applied hydrating treatment
is naturally sitting on the surface of the skin.

This creates a continuous translucent moisture film across the face.

The skin should appear:
hydrated,
slightly wet,
luminous,
supple,
freshly moisturized,
softly reflective.

Create glossy specular highlights across:
- cheekbones
- eyelids
- nose bridge
- side of the nose
- forehead
- upper lip
- lower lip
- chin

Tiny irregular micro-highlights should follow the real topology of the skin.

Some areas can appear almost mirror-like,
while other areas remain softly diffused.

The shine must NOT erase the skin texture.

Pores should still remain visible underneath the water-oil layer.

Do NOT create plastic skin.
Do NOT over-retouch.
Do NOT smooth away pores.
Do NOT make the skin uniformly glossy.

The final skin effect should feel like:

REAL SKIN
+
MOISTURE
+
FACIAL OIL
+
SERUM
+
WARM LIGHT

The skin is luminous because real light is interacting with moisture on the skin surface.

It should never look like digitally painted gloss.

LIGHT:
Warm late-afternoon or early-evening sunlight.

Soft golden beige, champagne, pale peach and muted blush tones.

The light enters strongly from the side and slightly behind the subject.

A narrow beam of sunlight may graze across:
- cheek
- eye
- eyelid
- nose
- lips
- forehead

Create strong contrast between glowing highlights and soft natural shadow.

The highlights should remain luminous and slightly overexposed in places.

The shadows remain deep, warm and transparent.

Do not flatten the lighting.

BACKLIGHT + LENS FLARE — CRITICAL:
Strong warm backlight must enter directly into the camera lens.

The light source may sit just outside the frame or partially inside the edge of the frame.

Allow the backlight to naturally create real optical artifacts:

- veiling flare
- lens flare
- analog halation
- highlight bloom
- lens ghosting
- light leaks
- washed luminous areas
- translucent haze
- soft overexposure
- subtle rainbow prism fragments
- pale champagne glow
- soft pink flare
- peach-orange light haze

IMPORTANT:

The lens flare does NOT need to avoid the face.

Allow the flare to move directly across the face.

It can pass across:
- one eye
- both eyes
- cheek
- forehead
- nose
- lips
- jaw

Parts of the face may temporarily lose contrast beneath the flare.

The flare may partially obscure facial details.

Do NOT preserve perfect facial clarity everywhere.

Some areas of the face can dissolve softly into light.

The flare should sometimes appear directly ON TOP OF the face, creating a translucent veil of light between the viewer and the woman.

This is intentional.

Bright highlights should softly bleed into surrounding areas instead of ending sharply.

The image should have beautiful analog highlight bloom and subtle halation.

The light should feel physical.

It should feel as if real sunlight is entering the lens and overwhelming the optics slightly.

Never make the lens flare look like a digital overlay or artificial Photoshop effect.

OPTICAL FOREGROUND — CRITICAL:
Place transparent or translucent optical material extremely close to the camera lens.

Possible material:
- thin transparent film
- clear plastic sheet
- translucent acrylic
- glass
- transparent fabric
- thin prism-like material
- reflective plastic
- semi-transparent packaging film

The material should remain mostly invisible as an object.

Instead, it should bend, scatter and reflect the incoming backlight.

It creates:

- blurred foreground light streaks
- transparent reflections
- champagne-colored haze
- pale pink flare
- peach-orange glow
- soft white veiling
- optical distortions
- stretched reflections
- broken highlights
- refracted light
- irregular luminous fragments
- subtle prism effects
- soft foreground blur

These optical elements are very close to the lens and therefore strongly out of focus.

IMPORTANT:

Do not arrange the optical effects neatly around the subject.

Allow them to overlap the face.

Some reflections may pass across:
- an eye
- cheek
- lips
- forehead
- nose

Some parts of the image may become blurred or partially obscured.

This should feel spontaneous and imperfect.

The photographer should feel like they are intentionally shooting THROUGH something.

Everything should appear created physically inside the camera rather than digitally added afterward.

CAMERA:
High-end fashion and beauty editorial photography.

85mm portrait lens look or equivalent medium-format portrait perspective.

Very shallow depth of field.

Focus precisely on one eye, cheek texture or skin surface.

Some eyelashes may be sharply resolved while surrounding areas fall softly out of focus.

The optical foreground must remain heavily blurred.

Use:
- subtle analog softness
- realistic lens diffusion
- fine film grain
- gentle highlight bloom
- slight halation
- natural optical imperfection
- subtle exposure breathing
- delicate falloff

The final image should feel like high-end medium-format film photography scanned beautifully.

Do not make everything clinically sharp.

TEXTURE TENSION — CRITICAL:
The visual beauty comes from the tension between:

hyper-real skin texture
and
partially blown-out optical light.

Pores remain visible underneath a wet luminous surface,
while lens flare occasionally erases or softens parts of the face.

This contrast is essential.

The viewer should simultaneously feel:

“I can almost touch the skin”

and

“I cannot completely see her.”

COLOR PALETTE:
Cream
ivory
champagne
warm beige
soft nude
pale peach
muted blush pink
subtle warm brown

Low saturation.

Soft warm neutral grading.

Avoid excessive orange.

Avoid strong yellow.

Avoid candy pink.

The overall color should feel expensive, quiet, natural and restrained.

MOOD:
Intimate.
Quiet.
Feminine.
Sensual without being sexual.
Private.
Softly melancholic.
Dreamlike but realistic.
Emotionally distant yet tender.

It should feel like a fleeting private moment caught between:

skin,
light,
memory
and silence.

The photograph should feel less like a beauty advertisement and more like a fragment of a memory.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Add only ONE very small emotional English sentence.

Use:

“Some feelings shimmer before they fade.”

Typography should be:
- very small
- elegant
- understated
- thin serif
- slightly italic
- refined editorial typography
- subtle letter spacing
- warm ivory / muted beige / soft brown

Place it discreetly in available negative space.

The text should never dominate the image.

It should feel discovered after looking at the photograph, not immediately noticed.

Do not use large headline typography.

SIGNATURE:
Add a very small signature:

Hu·X

Place it subtly near the lower area of the composition.

Use the same restrained editorial sensibility.

The signature must feel like an artist’s mark, not a logo.

FINAL FEEL:
Luxury beauty editorial photography.
Cinematic realism.
Poetic minimalism.
Tactile hydrated skin.
Wet luminous skin surface.
Real pores.
Warm backlight.
Optical refraction.
In-camera lens flare.
Analog halation.
Soft foreground distortion.
Quiet emotional tension.
Experimental fashion photography.
Sophisticated restraint.

The photograph should look genuinely photographed, not AI generated.

Avoid:
plastic skin,
beauty filter,
airbrushed skin,
perfect digital smoothness,
over-retouched face,
uniform glass skin,
fake digital shine,
CGI reflections,
fake lens flare,
obvious Photoshop glow,
perfect facial clarity everywhere,
symmetrical beauty portrait,
commercial skincare ad composition,
oversaturated orange tones,
heavy makeup,
large typography,
poster-like graphics,
too many design elements.

prompts.title: 走廊打斗
prompts.prompt:
A live-action thriller follows Sue leaving a luxury-hotel elevator and fighting bare-handed down the corridor as ten masked attackers try to stop her.

@[char ref] is the sole authority for Sue's complete appearance. Sue wears exactly its outfit, footwear, accessories, hairstyle, proportions, and materials throughout, with no redesign or substitution; ignore the white sheet, text, repeated views and poses.

The five-star corridor has brass elevator doors, burgundy carpet, warm sconces, suite doors, and alcoves. Exactly ten distinct attackers wear dark tailored suits and black cloth masks. All ten start in the corridor between the elevator and penthouse. No attacker starts inside the elevator; no bystanders.

Everyone remains unarmed. Sue uses grounded Wing Chun: centerline pressure, triangular footwork, pak sau, tan sau, bong sau, lap sau, chain punches, palm-heels, short elbows, and low stop kicks. Attackers actively box, kick, grab, body-lock, flank, and stagger pair attacks; Sue changes lanes and angles one into the other's path. Fallen attackers stay down permanently.

No dance occurs before the tenth attacker is fully down. Sue performs one party-girl dance only at the end.

Opening lock: Sue is the elevator's sole occupant. No attacker, limb, shadow, reflection, or silhouette appears inside the car. The first attacker waits out of frame in a corridor alcove three meters from the threshold. He appears only after Sue exits completely and the doors close, and he never crosses the threshold. Every fight occurs on the corridor carpet.

Use one continuous wide-lens Steadicam take. Begin facing the elevator and frame only Sue inside. Hold as she steps onto the carpet, revealing the empty car, then close the doors before revealing the first attacker. Lead Sue backward from the front along one reachable corridor path, arcing around contact and bodies. No cut, teleport, hidden transition, axis reset, slow motion, speed ramp, acrobatics, wirework, weapons, glowing trails, or energy effects.

0-2 seconds: The doors open on Sue alone. She exits unopposed, both feet reach the carpet, the empty elevator is clearly visible, and its doors close. No attacker is visible during this exit.

2-4 seconds: The first attacker now enters from the corridor alcove and attacks on the carpet; Sue uses pak sau, a straight palm, and a short elbow, then drops him beside the wall. Neither approaches the elevator threshold.

4-8 seconds: The second and third attackers converge, one punching and one grabbing; Sue lines them up, drops the second with lap sau and chain punches, then stops the third's renewed rush with a low kick and palm. Both stay down.

8-11 seconds: The fourth attacker charges from an alcove with a body lock; Sue turns him with bong sau and lap sau, finishes with short elbow-palm contact, and advances as he falls.

11-15 seconds: The fifth attacker engages Sue alone. The sixth stays three meters behind and outside engagement range, never striking, grabbing, or touching her. Sue drops the fifth with pak sau and compact centerline punches. Only after the fifth lies fully down does the sixth advance and begin a separate one-on-one body-lock attack; Sue turns him off-line with bong sau and lap sau, then drops him with a short elbow and palm. The two attacks never overlap and the men never engage Sue simultaneously.

15-18 seconds: The seventh attacker feints, blocks Sue's first counter, and returns a hook; Sue regains centerline with bong sau, lap sau, and chain punches, then drops him and advances.

18-23 seconds: The eighth and ninth coordinate front and rear pressure; Sue pivots the eighth into the ninth's path, drops him with elbow and palm, then intercepts the ninth's renewed rush with pak sau, a low kick, and a straight palm. Both stay down.

23-27 seconds: The tenth attacker blocks Sue's first chain punches, clinches, and drives her sideways into a suite door; Sue keeps her feet, works inside through tan sau, bong sau, and lap sau, then drops him with compact body punches and one palm-heel. All ten attackers are now down.

27-30 seconds: Sue performs the only dance, a brief confident shoulder shimmy, hip pop, and playful half-turn. The half-turn triggers a continuous camera move around her left side through a visible 180-degree arc. Without cutting, the camera settles directly behind Sue on the same corridor centerline, matches her forward direction, and follows her toward the penthouse. Fallen attackers remain fixed behind the moving camera.

Photoreal live action with realistic cloth, friction, impacts, and body weight. No dialogue and no BGM. Use elevator chime, doors, footsteps, suit cloth, breath, contact, wall impacts, and natural falls. Keep one Sue and the same ten attackers; preserve Sue's exact referenced outfit, identities, masks, positions, layout, and lighting with no duplication, replacement, disappearance, or respawning.

人物沿真实可见的建筑关系移动。
黄昏侧逆光，持续劲风卷沙。

UE级高质量国风3D CG动画。
PBR材质、全局光照、体积光、物理碎裂、布料模拟、真实毛发动态、接触阴影、金属反射、电影级色彩管理。

人物脸部、武器轮廓和攻防方向清楚。
【战斗类型】
30秒高速长兵器1V1。
无魔物。
无第三者。

核心看点是：
长枪与月牙长戟在攻击距离、兵器结构和空间位置上的高速博弈。
双方始终有攻有守。
【大师姐｜苍霆长枪】
大师姐以长枪的：
点、刺、拨、挑、扫、压、回杆反打
作为主要动作体系。

攻击中可以看到：
双手滑握。
前后手改变发力距离。
枪尾辅助转向。
细窄枪头寻找长戟侧刃之间的攻击空隙。
玄蓝枪芒只作为短促攻击延伸。

她会主动利用月牙结构：

封锁突刺方向。
拉开或压缩双方距离。

不是被动防守型角色。

每次碰撞之后都立即进入新的动作。

长枪直刺被月牙侧刃拨开后，大师姐顺势滑握缩短枪路，再利用枪杆或枪尾反击；
长戟横扫时，大师姐可以通过降低身体重心、改变握位或跃过戟刃进入新的攻击线。

踏石跃升。
上下位置交换。
短距离空中枪戟攻防。

进行弹射、俯冲、变向和追击。

双方均允许使用短距离高速位移。
大师姐：
玄蓝残影。
赤砂女战士：
赤金残影。

起点 → 短轨迹 → 终点凝实 → 立即攻击。

敌方重甲武者（对手锚点）：黑铁重甲，双持阔刀，身形高大笨重，动作迟缓但力道沉猛，甲片层叠。被击中时甲片逐片崩脱且不复原。特效物理性格＝钝重感：无能量外放，只有金属火花与甲片碎屑。

【明确特效】
雷火体系，全片三色：炽红雷火（主）、焦黑（破坏）、暗红（余韵）。禁止暖黄、橙金与冷白。

覆盖量：常规交锋每帧至少 40% 画面被雷火光效或焦尘覆盖；大招与峰值镜头至少 60%。
【空间与连续性】

【6—9秒｜凌空怒烈】Swift → Shock｜招式 3.0/秒 · 节拍 7/秒
低机位仰拍，TILT-U 急速上摇跟随刀修升空（单轴垂直连续运动），镜头轻微滞后于动作，强化滞空感。刀修拔地而起逆空冲天，双手持刀拉满圆弧，凌空劈出滔天雷火刀气。刀气如巨浪倾泻，垂直轰炸下方敌阵——镜头在最高点停住后转为垂直下摇，跟随刀气下坠（同轴连续，画面不断开），引发链式大爆炸，屏幕剧烈摇晃约 0.3 秒，岩浆状雷火光影四溅。敌方阵列被冲击波整排掀飞，快节奏撕裂战场。
【9—11秒｜瞬身突进】Whip｜招式 4.0/秒 · 节拍 10/秒
CU 特写赤瞳中雷芒暴涨约 0.4 秒，随后 WHIP 甩镜拉开为 FS。刀修化作一道赤红雷霆直线贯穿敌阵，拉出焦黑轨迹，沿途敌人悉数被狂暴气流掀飞。踩踏崩落的巨石连环借力，每一次折返伴随一声雷鸣。ORBIT 半环绕约 120° 跟随突进方向、焦点锁死刀锋（不做 360° 全环绕）。环绕结束后，刀修周身地煞符文瞬间怒张，狂暴冲击波清空全场。本镜含半透明符文层，运镜只保留轻微运动模糊，保住符文纹理与边缘。战场只剩纵横交错的赤红刀光。
【11—14秒｜绝杀裁决】Swift → Shock → Gentle｜招式 3.7/秒 · 节拍 9/秒
斜上方极速下坠，镜头垂直下坠跟随刀修（单一运动方向）。刀修强行抗下敌方核心一击，刀身一侧完美卸力，顺势双手握柄、大开大合拧身一记横切，将敌方核心拦腰斩断——接触帧锐利、白光暴闪、冲击波瞬间放大、敌方核心猛烈甩飞，重甲沿切口崩裂四散。随后借力跃起，拖刀从高空垂直下坠，一刀扎进大地。雷火狂龙自地表疯狂肆虐爆开：熔岩状雷火流沿地表蔓延，飞石与甲片碎屑四射，焦土扬尘冲上高空，正面将整片废墟彻底掀翻融化，大范围炽光致盲全场，覆盖不低于 60%。

震动余波平息，镜头 PULL gentle 缓缓后拉定帧，焦点锁定前景刀修。烟尘废墟中，刀修单膝跪地、单手撑刀，地面雷火游走；随即缓缓站起，长刀扛肩。远方焦黑的天空中，一只巨大的上古魔眼猛然睁开。刀修单手将刀缓缓指向前方，暗红披风狂舞，战意飙升至顶点。画面在最后 0.4 秒定格于终极决战爆发的凌厉临界点。
